title: Wire IpnsPublisher into main.rs drain task
description: In main.rs: 1. If config.ipns.enabled, create mpsc::channel::<IpnsEvent>(256). 2. Extract ipfs_for_ipns = rust_store.ipfs_handle() before boxing. 3. Spawn tokio task: IpnsPublisher::new(ipfs_for_ipns).run(ipns_rx). 4. In drain task Ok arm: after pinning events, if ipns enabled, for each group in result.groups, send IpnsEvent {group, cid: result.cid} to ipns_tx. Use try_send, log warn on channel full. 5. If config.ipns.disabled, do not allocate channel or spawn task. Thread ipns_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<IpnsEvent>> through the drain task closure. Why: hooks IPNS publishing to the article ingestion lifecycle.
